results.name: Wooden Ladle Spoon
results.description:
A ladle is a large spoon with a deep, bowl-shaped container and a long handle, used for serving liquids such as soup. Ladles are made in a variety of sizes depending upon use; for example, the smaller sizes of less than 5 inches (130 mm) in length are used for sauces or condiments, while extra large sizes of more than 15 inches (380 mm) in length are used for soup or punch.

This wooden spoon was hand carved in the mountains of North Carolina.

Scanned with Revopoint 3D Range scanner, in two files and then merged. High poly mesh.

results.name: Unhyun_ Ladle
results.description:
Unhyun_ Ladle
***사적_서울 운현궁_국자***

이 **국자**는 국이나 탕의 음식물을 떠서 다른 그릇으로 옮기는데 사용하는 큰 국자로 목자 또는 구지(句只), 구기(句器)라고도 불린다. 둥글고 구연부가 넓은 그릇 모양에 긴 자루를 붙여 만든다. 긴 자루와 타원형의 국자면이 직각을 이루도록 만들었다. **Unhyeongung Palace** was the residence of Heungseon Daewongun, father and regent of Emperor Gojong. It is also the place where Emperor Gojong was born and grew up. The historic site includes Heungseon Daewongun’s house and the western building, which was newly built in 1910 and was used as the main building of Duksung Women’s University...... 설명출처 : 국가문화유산포털. 서울역사박물관. <문화재정보 링크>
